title: jdk7 installer on Linux does not work for me

labels.name: P1
labels.description: I'll work on this now. (Assignee required)

body:
Please provide the following information. The more we know about your system and use case, the more easily and likely we can help.

### Description of the problem / feature request / question:
I used 
 bazel-0.4.2-jdk7-installer-linux-x86_64.sh 
to install bazel on RHEL 7.2 and Ubuntu 16.04

in both cases I get:

After installing with the jdk8  installer (which works) and reinstalling (with --user) even the jdk installation seems to work

### If possible, provide a minimal example to reproduce the problem:

I followed the Java introduction
